method: Kabsch rigid-body least-squares fit over identity-matched C-alpha atom pairs; no reflection
correspondence_basis: Same author residue identifier and insertion code; sequence identity checked
limitations: Differences may reflect construct, method, conditions or conformation; mutation causation is not established.
Only the first coordinate model and selected observed protein chains are used.
The alignment transform and aligned display copy are saved separately; original coordinates remain immutable.
No folding, energy, binding or stability model was run.
